title: GitHub Swift Languages Daily Trending
description: Daily Trending of Swift Languages in GitHub

items.title: robinebers / openusage
items.description: Burning through your subscriptions too fast? Paying for stuff you never use? Stop guessing. OpenUsage is free and open source.

items.title: milika / SmartTubeIOS
items.description: Native Swift/SwiftUI YouTube client for iPhone, iPad, Apple TV & Mac — ad-free, SponsorBlock, DeArrow, Google sign-in, up to 8K. Open source.

items.title: altic-dev / FluidVoice
items.description: Fastest and only macOS Dictation app with on-device STT and custom trained AI enhancement model. Windows, iOS testflight! Android, Linux waitlist open! A local Wispr Flow alternative. Follow https://x.com/fluidvoiceapp for more

items.title: ggml-org / Llama-macOS
items.description: A cosy home for your LLMs.

items.title: pointfreeco / swift-composable-architecture
items.description: A library for building applications in a consistent and understandable way, with composition, testing, and ergonomics in mind.

items.title: jithin-sabu / purge-app
items.description: Free up your Mac. Safely. A free, open-source native Mac app that clears the cache and junk your Mac piles up on its own. Files go to the Trash by default, so you can put them back.

items.title: manaflow-ai / cmux
items.description: Open source Ghostty-based macOS terminal with vertical tabs and notifications for AI coding agents. Built for multitasking, organization, and programmability.

items.title: carloslfu / slotstream
items.description: Run a 105 GB AI model on a Mac that can't hold it. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 4-bit, streamed from SSD on 16–64 GB Apple Silicon Macs. Fully native Swift, MLX and Metal. Offline, no Python. CLI, Swift library, and Ollama/OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Works with Claude Code and Codex.

items.title: cmagnussen / blitztext-app
items.description: Local-first dictation for macOS. Speak, text, done. Parakeet or Whisper on your Mac, writing modes with Apple Intelligence. Free, MIT.

items.title: mattt / iMCP
items.description: A macOS app that provides an MCP server to your Messages, Contacts, Reminders and more

items.description: Orchestrate Claude, Codex and Grok in one app. Open-source (MIT), reuses the subscriptions you already pay for.
